Anna: P0 customer BrightCart reporting function invoke failures post-deploy at ~06:10. They get schema validation 400: "null value for required field 'unit_price'" when calling `POST /v1/functions/invoke`. Request id: f2a9b7d2. Logs attached.

Ben: can you paste the failing payload + request-id? Also which tool were they routed to?

Anna: payload snippet:
```
{"order_id":"OC123","items":[{"sku":"ABC","qty":1,"unit_price":null}]}
```
They said they call `order_total` tool via function call. Request-id: f2a9b7d2

Raj: seeing similar failures in nightly evals — CI golden test `toolcall_schema/price_required` started failing after runtime change. Stack shows `schema_validator: allow_null=false` applied to nested lists.

maria: CI logs (nightly):
```
FAIL toolcall_schema/price_required
AssertionError: expected non-null for items[0].unit_price
```
Locally my branch passed, flaky repro.

sre-bot: deploy at 2024-05-06T06:10:12Z by @deploy-bot. Rollout tag: v2.11.3

deploy-bot: can confirm feature flag `strict_tool_schema` toggled on in canary.

Ben: hypothesis: strict flag default flipped for canary/pin. Two immediate paths: 1) toggle flag rollback, 2) hotfix serializer to accept missing price for legacy callers and coerce to 0. Need customer impact list.

Anna: other customers also reported elevated latency (~400ms -> ~900ms) for function-routing since deploy, plus a couple 401 auth for tool calls (same timeframe) — might be related to new router middleware.

Ben: auth 401s look like token-introspect failures for customers on older plans — sending query to billing team to confirm token refresh window change. @raj can you run golden eval with `strict_tool_schema=false` and post diff?

Raj: running now, will paste results. If CI passes with flag off, we'll ship rollback. Also adding a smoke test to CI to catch toolcall schema regressions.

Anna: customer escalated to P0, asked for ETA. Saying they cannot process orders. :rotating_light: 

Ben: pinging oncall to coordinate rollback. If rollback not possible within 30m, we'll patch serializer and push hotfix.

maria: adding repro steps to support ticket and attaching sample payloads + request-id. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/RC-7890

Anna: thanks — I'll keep customer updated.
